# ToastStack

Notifications stacked into one card with the two behind peeking out; point at it or tab into it and it springs apart into a list.

`IK.ToastStack` · Cart & checkout

## Use

```jsx
<IK.ToastStack toasts={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.ToastStack" toasts="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ToastStackProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toasts` * | `Array<Toast & { id: string }>` |  |
| `onDismiss` | `(id: string) => void` |  |
| `placement` | `'bottom-right' \| 'bottom-center' \| 'inline'` |  |
| `duration` | `number` |  |
| `peek` | `number` | px each card behind peeks out. Default 12. |
| `gap` | `number` | px between cards when open. Default 10. |
| `visible` | `number` | Cards shown in the stack. Default 3. |
